$comment: M1 PBR material library manifest. scripts/build-materials.mjs reads this, downloads the CC0 sources into art/materials/src/ (not committed), and writes client/public/textures/pbr/{2k,1k}/<id>_{albedo,normal,orm}.ktx2 plus client/src/village/pbr/pbrManifest.generated.ts. tileMeters = real-world size of one texture tile (from the source's published dimensions where it has them; 'est' marks an estimate). density = the plan's target px/m (PLAN.md section 3).

sets.label: 아스팔트 (마을 순환 도로, 주차장)
sets.use: Road surface: ring road, parking. Fine cracks; tyre-mark/patch macro variation is G1/vrb2's job.

sets.label: 보도블록 (인터로킹 200x100)
sets.use: Sidewalks and bus-stop apron: grey 200x100 concrete blocks in running bond.

sets.label: 광장 화강석 판석
sets.use: Plaza slabs: grey granite (거창석-like) large-format slabs with real joints. Add per-slab tint jitter and water-stain macro in the shader.
sets.note: The scan is a brown-grey granite; desaturated and lifted toward the light grey of Korean 거창석 plaza slabs.

sets.label: 화강석 버너 마감 (연석, 화분대, 분수 갓돌)
sets.use: Jointless flamed granite for curbs (1 m segments: put the joint in the geometry), planter copings, fountain basin, bollards, steps.
sets.note: The source is a polished countertop granite; the pipeline turns it into a flamed (burner) finish: lighter, lower contrast, rough (0.71-0.85) with crystal micro-relief derived from the albedo.

sets.label: 잔디
sets.use: Lawns and empty lots. Real lawn photo scan; desaturated a little toward Korean countryside grass. Blend with dirt_path through a mask for worn patches.
sets.note: ambientCG's roughness map averages 0.26, which made the lawn glint like plastic; remapped to ~0.78.

sets.label: 흙길 (마사토)
sets.use: Footpaths, worn ground under benches, field edges, flower-bed soil.
sets.note: Desaturated from ochre toward the beige-grey of Korean 마사토.

sets.label: 자갈 (강자갈)
sets.use: Creek bed and banks, drainage strips, gravel parking, under the pavilion eaves.

sets.label: 드라이비트 (흰색 스타코)
sets.use: Korean countryside house walls (드라이비트/스타코 흰색·미색). Tint with material.color for off-white; add rain streaks under windows as a macro mask.

sets.label: 세라믹 사이딩 (가로 패널)
sets.use: Horizontal fibre-cement / ceramic lap siding on house walls and gables. Grey; tint for beige/white variants.

sets.label: 목재 사이딩
sets.use: Horizontal lap wood siding: the cafe, the bait shop, sheds.

sets.label: 징크 / 칼라강판 지붕
sets.use: Standing-seam style metal roofs (리얼징크, 칼라강판), container and shed walls, fence sheets. Recoloured to dark zinc grey; tint with material.color for blue/red 강판.

sets.label: 아스팔트 슁글
sets.use: Asphalt shingle roofs of the newer houses.
sets.note: Source tile is 8 m, so the 2K set is 256 px/m (below the 512 target) — fine at roof viewing distance; never put it within 2 m of the camera.

sets.label: 기와 (짙은 회색 점토 기와)
sets.use: Pavilion (정자) and traditional roofs: dark grey clay tiles in rows, ridges in the normal map. Lay the rows along the eaves.
sets.note: RoofingTiles013A reads glazed (roughness 0.5); Korean fired 기와 are matte, so roughness is lifted by 0.2.

sets.label: 노출 콘크리트
sets.use: Memorial hall walls, foundations, retaining walls, utility poles' bases, L-gutters.

sets.label: 적벽돌
sets.use: Red-brick houses, garden walls, chimneys.

sets.label: 자연석 바위
sets.use: Creek boulders, stone-wall stones, landscaping rocks (same source as today's T_rock/T_stone, now with normal + roughness).

sets.label: 원목 마루
sets.use: Interior hardwood floors (houses, cafe, memorial hall).

sets.label: 강마루 (밝은 오크)
sets.use: Light-oak laminate floors typical of Korean houses and apartments.

sets.label: 흰색 타일 (욕실, 주방 벽)
sets.use: Bathroom and kitchen wall tiles, cafe counter front.

sets.label: 벽지 (흰색 실크/우드칩)
sets.use: Interior walls and ceilings. Tint with material.color for beige or pastel wallpaper.

sets.label: 도장 미장벽
sets.use: Painted plaster walls (cafe, memorial hall back rooms, stairwells).

sets.label: 데크 목재
sets.use: Outdoor decks, the cafe terrace, bridge planks, picnic tables, bench slats (rotate UVs along the slat).
sets.note: The scan is a red-stained hardwood deck; desaturated toward 방부목 / composite deck browns.

sets.label: 오크 무늬목 (가구)
sets.use: Furniture, door leaves, counters, frames, the pavilion's oiled pillars (tint darker).

sets.label: 분체도장 강철 (검정/진회색)
sets.use: Powder-coated steel: bench frames, railings, lamp and sign poles, bollards, bus-stop frame. Tint with material.color for dark grey or green.
sets.note: ambientCG ships metalness 1 for this powder-coated steel; powder coat is paint (a dielectric), so metalness is forced to 0.

sets.label: 헤어라인 알루미늄
sets.use: Window frames, door handles, kiosk trim, signal housings, mailbox fronts.

sets.label: 주철 (검정 도장, 마모)
sets.use: Cast-iron bench legs, manhole and drain covers, the fountain's spout, old pump.

sets.label: 패브릭 (소파, 방석)
sets.use: Sofas, cushions, chair seats, curtains. Neutral grey; tint with material.color.

sets.label: 붉은 점토 기와 (유럽 시골 학교 지붕)
sets.use: New red clay pantile roofs of the European storybook lots (village school). Brand-new: no moss, no lichen; lay the rows along the eaves.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). A clean, brand-new interlocking clay tile scan (ambientCG RoofingTiles012A, 2.9 m); Poly Haven roof_tiles was tried first and dropped (lichen-blotched).

sets.label: 흰 칠 목재 (창틀, 울타리, 큐폴라, 판벽)
sets.use: Freshly painted timber: window frames and glazing bars, picket fences, cupolas, porches, trims. White; tint with material.color for sage, green or blue paint.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). Desaturated and lifted toward clean white paint; roughness lowered (fresh paint is a little glossier).

sets.label: 놀이터 고무 바닥 (안전 매트)
sets.use: Rubber safety tiles under swings, slides and climbing frames (EPDM playground tiles). Recoloured to terracotta red; tint for green.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). The scan is black gym tiles; recoloured to the terracotta red of playground safety tiles.

sets.label: 놀이 모래 (모래밭)
sets.use: Clean play sand in sandpits and long-jump pits.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). Recoloured toward clean, light play sand.

sets.label: 꿀색 석회암 마름돌 (성당 벽, 도서관 장식)
sets.use: Honey-coloured dressed limestone ashlar: chapel walls, the library's bands, arches, quoins, sills and copings. Brand-new: clean faces, crisp joints.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). Lifted a little toward fresh-cut limestone.

sets.label: 천연 슬레이트 지붕
sets.use: Natural slate roofs (library, chapel): even blue-grey slates in courses, brand-new.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B1 (2026-11-17). Clean square natural slates (ambientCG RoofingTiles003), recoloured from green-grey to blue-grey Welsh slate. Poly Haven roof_slates_03 was tried first and dropped (a ridge strip in the tile).

sets.label: 새 동판 (녹청 없는 밝은 구리)
sets.use: Brand-new copper: the chapel spire's cross and finial, the church steeple's spire tip, rain heads and flashing, lantern caps, the fountain spout. No verdigris, no tarnish (lots v2: "모두 새것").
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B2 (2026-11-17). ambientCG Metal047A (CC0): clean, freshly rolled copper sheet with a faint hammered ripple.

sets.label: 단청 (절 목부재 채색 아틀라스)
sets.use: Fresh Korean temple dancheong on timber: a painted ATLAS (tileMeters 1, process.atlas), not a tiling texture. Regions (docs/designs/village-lots-v2/tools/temple_atlas.py): 머리초 beams, 서까래·부연 sides and ends, 주의초, 우물반자 연화, 공포 초엽, 수미단 모란 relief, 운문, 금단청 넝쿨 (gold leaf = metal), 연등 paper, and a neutral paint strip to tint (석간주 columns, 주칠 frames).
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B3 (2026-11-17). Hand-painted from observation of real temple dancheong (general 머리초/금단청 forms, brand-new colours, no 卍, no letters) by docs/designs/village-lots-v2/tools/temple_dancheong.py; the wood grain under the paint is Poly Haven hinoki_planks' normal (CC0). Own work, CC0.

sets.label: 소나무 백골 (마루, 백골 부재)
sets.use: Natural unpainted pale softwood (Korean pine 소나무 look): the 대웅전 우물마루 floor, 툇마루, the 일주문's unpainted parts, 방석 frames, temple furniture. Brand-new, oiled.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B3 (2026-11-17). Clean raw softwood planks with small knots (Poly Haven hinoki_planks, 1.89 m), close to fresh Korean pine 마루.

sets.label: 화강석 돌담·석축 (절 담장)
sets.use: Temple 돌담 and 석축: grey granite blocks laid with fine joints, brand-new and clean (under a 기와 coping); the 대웅전 기단 sides, the 범종각 and 석등 bases.
sets.note: Added by lots v2 B3 (2026-11-17). Grey granite irregular-block wall (Poly Haven japanese_stone_wall, 1.9 m): the look of a new Korean temple 돌담·석축 (no moss).
